title: Privacy Features
excerpt: Understand Kahana Browser's privacy features and how they protect your data.
content:
Privacy Features

Kahana Browser includes comprehensive privacy features to protect your data:

Data Protection

  • End-to-end encryption
  • Secure data storage
  • Automatic data cleanup

Privacy Controls

  • Cookie management
  • Tracking prevention
  • Private browsing modes

Enterprise Privacy

  • Data retention policies
  • Audit logging
  • Compliance reporting
